_CRITICAL_NOTE: Assets (6).png is an ASSET SHEET, not a picture of the assembled player. A sheet deliberately lays pieces out side by side so every piece is visible/selectable — its layout is a CATALOG arrangement, not the player's real mounted geometry. Every x/y below is a sourceSheetPosition (where a piece was physically found on the sheet) and MUST NOT be read as assembledPlayerPosition. No assembledPlayerCoordinates exist yet for this player — see assembledPlayerCoordinates below. Do not attempt another visual composition pass until a real assembled-reference (a picture of the ACTUAL mounted device) is supplied. asset-sheet-cropped.png (formerly misnamed assembled-reference.png) is the asset sheet with catalog metadata masked out — it is a piece-library contact sheet, not a mounting plan, and Player Lab must not present it as a composition-accuracy reference.
